title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-svpz: test_key_change_detection uses tx_history[0] twice, queues duplicate frame
description:
File: python/tests/link/test_link_layer.py:574

In test_key_change_detection, after peer_ll.send(b"second"), peer_radio.tx_history is [frame1, frame2], but the test accesses peer_radio.tx_history[0] which returns frame1 again. The node receives a duplicate of frame1 instead of the new frame2.

The test passes by accident because KEY_CHANGE detection (link_layer.py:562-563) runs before REPLAY detection (link_layer.py:593). If these checks were ever reordered, or if someone added an early REPLAY return for efficiency, the test would silently start testing the wrong thing — or fail altogether since it would hit REPLAY before KEY_CHANGE.

Fix: use peer_radio.tx_history[-1] on line 574 to retrieve the most recent transmit (the second frame). This ensures the test validates that a genuinely new frame from the same peer triggers KEY_CHANGE, not just a duplicate of the first frame.
